text: In February 2026, Grab's board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program allowing the company to repurchase up to **$500 million** worth of its outstanding Class A ordinary shares [Grab, FY2025, p.135]. This is the same $500 million size as the prior program authorized in February 2024, and the new program has no fixed end date, does not obligate Grab to repurchase any specific amount, and may be suspended or terminated at any time [Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].

answer: In February 2026, Grab's board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program allowing the company to repurchase up to **$500 million** worth of its outstanding Class A ordinary shares [Grab, FY2025, p.135]. This is the same $500 million size as the prior program authorized in February 2024, and the new program has no fixed end date, does not obligate Grab to repurchase any specific amount, and may be suspended or terminated at any time [Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].
